messages.subject: Raykov's reliability
parts:
Hi, could someone here show me how to calculate the Raykov's reliability from the fitted CFA lavaan object?

 I used to use the 'standardized' option in mplus and then calculate by hand. I tried to use the standardizedsolution() function, but found no standard error for observed items.

Thanks


Huashan Chen

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: Raykov's reliability
parts:
Here is the example script for calculating the Raykov's reliability:

library(lavaan)

HS.model <- '
visual  =~ load1*x1 + load2*x2 + load3*x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9
x1 ~~ e1*x1
x2 ~~ e2*x2
x3 ~~ e3*x3
totalload := (load1 + load2 + load3)^2
totalerror := e1 + e2 + e3
relia := totalload / (totalload + totalerror)
'

fit <- cfa(HS.model, data=HolzingerSwineford1939, std.lv=TRUE)
summary(fit)

I have a plan to add a function to calculate the reliability in semTools. Hope I will have it soon.

Sunthud

I have added the reliability function in the semTools package which is available in the development version. To install it, please use

install.packages("semTools", repos="http://rweb.quant.ku.edu/kran")
See the example by

library(semTools)
?reliability

The point estimate of the reliability is available only.

Best,
Sunthud

this belongs in semTools, not lavaan.

In attach the code. Perhaps it can be merged with your function to
